summary: Iter-157 Verified Live Performance + Audit Log — full backend + frontend E2E PASS. Backend pytest (6/6 in tests/test_iter157_verified_perf_audit.py + iter153 step-up regression 6/6): (B1) GET /api/performance/verified as admin returns 200 with overall{net_pnl≈6910, deals≈2262, win_rate≈68 — exact: net_pnl=6910.18, deals within tolerance}, max_drawdown, equity_curve (list of {date,net,cum}), 8 accounts with real labels (micro, OnEquity, Start Trader, etc.), integrity{source:'broker_deals', closed_trades=488, verified_pct=99.8, estimated_or_unknown_excluded=1, freshest_heartbeat_age_sec≈28733}, share=null initially. (B2) share lifecycle end-to-end: POST /api/performance/share → {share_id}; unauthenticated GET /api/public/performance/{sid} → 200 with ALL 8 labels masked as ACCOUNT-1..ACCOUNT-8, shared:true, integrity+equity_curve+overall present; second POST rotates share (old id → 404, new id → 200); GET /api/performance/verified now returns share with new share_id; DELETE /api/performance/share → subsequent public GET → 404; bogus share id → 404; public endpoint works from a completely cookieless requests.Session. (B3) GET /api/auth/audit?limit=200 returns list of {action, detail, step_up_verified, ip, at} — 33 items in current env, all with step_up_verified=true (all triggered by live-sensitive actions). Frontend E2E: (F1) /performance via nav-performance sidebar renders integrity-stamp (green BROKER-VERIFIED RECORD text with '99.8% of 488 closed trades broker-verified · 1 estimates excluded · source: broker_deals · feed 28733s ago'), verified-stats tiles, equity-curve recharts AreaChart, verified-accounts table (8 rows with real labels 'micro/OnEquity/Start Trader/…' shown to owner), share-controls. share-create → share-url appears with /p/{id}; share-copy triggers 'Link copied' sonner toast (with clipboard perms granted); opening share URL in a NEW browser context WITHOUT any auth cookies → public-performance page renders integrity-stamp, StatTiles, EquityCurve, and AccountsTable with ALL labels masked as ACCOUNT-1..ACCOUNT-8; back in app share-revoke → share-create button returns → revisiting same URL in fresh context now shows public-perf-error 'This share link is invalid or has been revoked.' (F2) /audit-log via nav-audit-log renders audit-log-table with 33 audit-event-{i} rows, 33 '2FA VERIFIED' badges (all events step_up_verified=true), audit-filters chip row, audit-log-refresh works. NOTE: audit-filter-step_up_verified chip is not present because 'step_up_verified' is not itself an audit action name (chips render one per unique action.action) — the 2FA VERIFIED badge is driven by the boolean step_up_verified field, not the action name; the review request wording likely conflates the two. Filter chips DO show for actual action names like 'live_activation'/'api_key_created'/etc. (F-Regression) /dashboard, /analytics research-panel and /scalp scalp-review-panel all still render. Zero blocking console errors.

issues: In headless/permission-denied browsers navigator.clipboard.writeText rejects and — because copy() awaits nothing and doesn't .catch() — surfaces as a React runtime-error overlay that then blocks subsequent clicks on the page (share-revoke) until the overlay is dismissed. Not user-visible with normal browser prompts (Chrome/Firefox request clipboard perms and after Grant it works). Suggested tiny fix: wrap `navigator.clipboard?.writeText(shareUrl)` in a try/catch or `.catch(() => toast.error('Copy blocked — copy manually'))` in VerifiedPerformance.jsx::copy(). Purely defensive, not required for acceptance.

action_items: (Optional/nice-to-have) Harden VerifiedPerformance.jsx::copy() with try/catch around navigator.clipboard.writeText so a rejected clipboard write does not raise an uncaught runtime error overlay. Not blocking iter-157 acceptance.
(Optional) Consider auto-hiding revoked share_id from GET /api/performance/verified.share — already done: rotate/delete both correctly null the share field.
critical_code_review_comments: performance_routes.py: _verified_payload aggregates directly from db.broker_deals (never from estimated trades.pnl) and gates integrity.verified_pct on trades.broker_deal_id != null AND excludes pnl_estimated/pnl_unknown — the design matches the spec ('never estimates'). Good.

performance_routes.py: create_share uses secrets.token_urlsafe(16) (128-bit entropy) — unguessable. Rotation logic sets revoked:True on ALL prior shares for the user before inserting new — clean audit trail preserved.

performance_routes.py: public_router.get uses no auth dep — correct, and the aggregator is called with mask=True which relabels accounts as ACCOUNT-N. Broker/mode fields ARE still passed through in public payload (e.g., 'RoboForex', 'live') — verify this is acceptable to product; leaks broker identity but no account IDs/labels/PII. Not flagged as a bug (spec calls for label masking only).
public payload also passes through integrity.freshest_heartbeat_age_sec and generated_at — fine, no PII.
VerifiedPerformance.jsx: copy() should catch clipboard-write rejection (see design_issues above).

AuditLog.jsx: filter chips render one per unique action.action found in the fetched list. The review-request wording 'click audit-filter-step_up_verified' does not correspond to an action name — step_up_verified is a boolean flag on rows, and the badge rendering IS driven by that flag. UI is internally consistent; suggest either (a) rename the badge to match filter naming, or (b) add a synthetic 'STEP-UP EVENTS' toggle that filters rows where step_up_verified=true, so the spec wording maps 1:1. Minor UX-consistency, non-blocking.
PublicPerformance.jsx: uses raw axios (not the api client with auth interceptor) — correct choice for an unauth endpoint, otherwise the shared api instance would attach auth cookies/CSRF.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids + share lifecycle + no-auth public render + revoke error + audit log + regression)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing DB. 488 auto-closed trades, 2262 broker_deals, 8 broker-verified accounts (micro/OnEquity/Start Trader/…), 33 pre-existing audit_log entries all with step_up_verified=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-157 Verified Performance + Audit Log is fully green. Reusable backend test: /app/backend/tests/test_iter157_verified_perf_audit.py (6 tests) — covers verified shape+expected totals, share create/rotate/delete/public-no-auth/bogus 404, and audit list. Note: (1) mask=True only masks account label; broker+mode ARE passed through in public payload; (2) audit filter chips are one-per-unique-action.action, so 'step_up_verified' chip only exists if any event has that literal action name — in current env all 33 events have step_up_verified=True but action names vary; badge rendering is fine but the filter-name naming isn't 1:1 with the review spec (documented in action_items and code_review_comments as minor UX polish, not a bug); (3) VerifiedPerformance.jsx copy() lacks try/catch around navigator.clipboard.writeText — in headless browsers without clipboard perms this raises a runtime-error overlay that blocks subsequent clicks (test workaround: page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write'])). Real users are unaffected. Iter-153 step-up regression 6/6 still green.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. Two minor polish opportunities noted above.
